title: Saturday Guided Distillery Tour and Whiskey Tasting
includes: Discussion, tour and tasting with a team member
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Go behind the barrels with your Signature Guided Tour and Tasting. This exclusive experience takes you into the heart of our distillery, where you’ll walk the working floors, explore your casks, and learn the art of whiskey-making from the experts. Discover the tradition and intention behind your process and see why we are America’s first dedicated Single Pot Still whiskey distillery. It is an immersive blend of education and flavor, designed to give you a deeper appreciation for every pour. Join us for a unique look at the craft behind the glass.
